result.title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
result.summary: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对投机解码 drafter 的自回归训练-推理不匹配，提出两种仅训练期方法：HSM 在同一预测目标对应的 backbone 与 MTP 隐状态间采样混合，HSGD 随机阻断隐状态与嵌入通路的梯度但保留前向，均不增加推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对「递归生成隐状态造成训练-推理分布偏移」的刻画与状态混合、梯度截断式正则，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与状态更新提供可核查的借鉴线索；但任务本身是加速解码，与多模态视觉推理无直接联系。
